summary: Native merge target branches can advance after the PR-associated base was selected. Two-parent source qualification therefore binds the exact PR head as second parent, authenticates first-parent equality or strict descent from the associated base through native comparison and independently fetched local ancestry, and reproduces the source tree through the existing complete-frontier unique-base clean three-way composition proof. Ancestry alone never qualifies source bytes; composition is required even when source/head trees match. Unknown, divergent or malformed advancement, incorrect parent order, shallow incomplete graph and extra source contents refuse. Original failed observations remain evidence and no credential retry or publication authority follows from source tests. One-parent squash semantics and final native association/stability readbacks are retained.
title: Ordinary settlement must authenticate merge shape and prove source composition
